answer: Keep capacity as a flow that decays unless yarrow meters it into a marble root each epoch: marble treats roots with shared funding as one operator, and an agent speaks only while its root sends that head at least 1 umber per epoch. A root feeding r live heads must send r+1 to add the next; any stream split below 1 lapses. First head: one root, 1 umber. n clones on one root: n(n+1)/2 umber every epoch; extra roots need unrelated umber, not fresh keys.
